scope: Namespace-aware origin repair and at most one finite import/save/capture/visual start

requirements.requirement: Current baseline, C211 held and executed source identities, C214/C215 authority/profile and accepted source input triple are pinned; prior source and failed evidence remain unchanged.

Exact installed Blender executable and all installed importer-source bytes are hashed before native execution and checked again at native starts; Unknown upstream build lineage is reported without claiming source reproducibility.
Exact capture implementation and all imported local helper bytes are bound to a committed source identity; the reviewer sees the complete native and launch code before launch.

A separate C217 experimental contract explicitly adopts exact retained source authority plus measured native shading/disclosed loss. It grants no native normal fidelity, replacement tolerance, production integration or retroactive C211 pass.

A fresh finite plan defines at most one native start: import/save/capture/render. Exact command, source, time/resource bounds, expected files, comparison gates and stop rules are fixed. No exploratory native start, reopen, automatic retry or unplanned rerender.
Every attempted start is durably recorded before launch; timeout/unknown outcomes are counted and reconciled before any retry. No automatic retry or unplanned rerender is permitted.

The plan distinguishes immutable prelaunch source/build/importer/settings locks from the post-save scene hash. A future scene hash cannot be represented as preknown. Final per-phase C215 observation locks are independently checked against the prelaunch bindings and actual saved scene.

The source is a separately identified future-proposed receiver, not relabeled held C211 correction. Denoising is explicitly disabled in actual Cycles scene and view-layer settings if Cycles is selected; the executed settings receipt verifies the correction.

Captured positions and corner normals come from actual native object-local mesh/loop data. Source normals never select correspondence or overwrite imported normals; unrelated geometry fixes, coordinate rounding, welding and topology alterations are absent.
Captured native object, mesh, triangle and loop identities are explicit. Source instance binding uses retained metadata and validated source IDs rather than relying on incidental native ordering.

All expected 18 source instances, 7800 triangle instances and 23400 corners enter the denominator. Missing, ambiguous, invalid, unmatched and reversed-winding records remain visible rather than being dropped.
An independent raw GLB reader reconstructs accepted local float32 positions/normals and original topology without using adapter correspondence or source-normal builder as its oracle.

Independent correspondence uses source identity plus exact positions and orientation-preserving cyclic winding only, with fixed Blender (X,Y,Z) to glTF (X,Z,-Y) mapping. Drift/ambiguity is a blocker, not a relaxed tolerance.
Component and angular loss are independently recomputed for every mapped corner; reported maxima, complete state counts and native IDs agree with independently derived values.
The original 2e-6 normal threshold is reported separately as historical comparison and remains failed if exceeded; no new shading-fidelity pass is inferred from small loss.
requirements.evidence: NATIVE-CORNER-LOSS-AUDIT.json: original strict normal gate remains FAIL

requirements.requirement: Native imported object identity, PBR values, selected world poses/units/frames and supported source semantics are checked against authoritative accepted source. Metadata preservation is distinguished from executable physics.

The actual saved .blend exists, is nonempty and is hashed. Accepted source-normal payload bytes and source references survive as paired retained authority; any in-scene source metadata/text claims are verified from actual native observations.
Saved-scene reopen remains explicitly UNRUN and deferred to a later separately reviewed task. C216 run-02 stays consumed and cannot supply a remaining retry or reopen allowance.
requirements.evidence: No reopen command/approval route/artifacts or execution; final gates explicitly retain UNRUN

requirements.requirement: No saved-scene round-trip or reopen preservation is claimed from an import-only capture; all future reopen gates remain separate and pending.
requirements.evidence: No reopen command/approval route/artifacts or execution; final gates explicitly retain UNRUN

requirements.requirement: Useful actual native renders are generated from the inspected imported scene with declared camera/light/render settings, including views exposing the object assembly and sphere shading. Source and render bytes are bound.
A human-facing visual inspection checks framing, missing/extra parts, material appearance and visible surface shading. A successful render exit or numeric small error alone is not shading review.
Per-phase output/log/run receipts, measured settings, environment/build identity and process termination evidence are preserved; a successful launch never stands in for complete expected artifacts.

Only the isolated C217 experiment and root-owned navigation/status are changed. No prior adapter contract, source/runtime/exporter, held receiver, frozen schedule, tolerances or historical evidence is rewritten.

C215 reports retain their fixed false evidence/provenance/fidelity flags. Any separate C217 result states only the external measured proof actually reviewed and keeps exact-source authority distinct from native representation.

All required independent findings are accounted for with PASS/FAIL/UNRUN/BLOCKED evidence. A failed finite gate stops further native steps and produces a restorable checkpoint; full runtime regression/native lossless or general receiving claims are absent.
Workers preserve source and original attempts; final package retains history/hashes and exact source/evidence references. Root owns final archive/offline restore/save verification and stopping.
requirements.evidence: Reviewer source and detailed evidence written and frozen; final package/restoration/save owned by root

requirements.requirement: Every loaded importer entry has complete raw file, module/spec loader class, spec origin, cached path and module/spec search locations durably recorded before classification may reject it. Missing metadata is explicit, never silently replaced by guessed values.

Concrete modules require supported source loader, exact pinned source file and module name, consistent spec/file/search metadata, unchanged source bytes and absent existing bytecode; source/cache bindings stay strict.

Namespace packages require supported namespace loader, explicit absence of concrete source/origin/cache, exact expected package name and contained canonical locations derived from pinned importer Python inventory. Mixed, external, conflicting, escaped, missing or contradictory locations reject.

Meaningful independent CPU controls cover legitimate concrete/namespace cases, missing/contradictory metadata, alien or mixed search locations, source drift and stale bytecode. Native compatibility is not inferred from CPU controls.

note: Independent predeclared requirements. Not launch authorization. Reopen is explicitly deferred; one failure or unknown consumes the only start and closes this task.
meaning: All 30 requirements accounted for. Passing reporting/scope requirements do not turn the preserved strict normal failure or unrun reopen gate into a receiving pass. Root delivery requirement remains pending root closure.
